principle: Execution constraints make a scientific proposition testable; they must NOT prescribe which scientific proposition should be generated.

allowed_execution_constraints.purpose: Bound the hypothesis space to falsifiable, runnable experiments

includes.use: Define what measurements exist — not which relationships are scientifically interesting
Ensure population is parseable and executable
Ensure outcome is measurable on panel
Horizon must be selectable for test — not pre-selected to match hidden edge
Map proposition to runnable tool path

forbidden_as_generative_priors.purpose: These tell the generator WHAT should be interesting — excluded from OPR synthesis inputs

includes.reason: Human scientific prior encoding which uncertainty types matter
Optimizes for template-distance, not observational surprise

includes.category: PREFERRED POPULATIONS/HORIZONS FROM PRIOR BB RUNS

TEST_EXEC_01.scenario: Generator receives only execution metadata, no raw evidence
TEST_EXEC_01.expected: Zero autonomous propositions OR all INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

TEST_EXEC_02.scenario: Same raw evidence + full GAP catalog vs raw evidence + execution metadata only
TEST_EXEC_02.expected: GAP-enriched run must NOT show higher SCIENTIFICALLY_NOVEL rate unless raw-grounded; any excess likely TEMPLATE_INSTANCE

TEST_EXEC_03.scenario: Strong anomaly with no legal population/outcome expression
TEST_EXEC_03.expected: Proposition may be drafted but executability_status=NOT_EXECUTABLE; must not force illegal ExperimentSpec

TEST_EXEC_04.expected: Record retained with executability_status=REJECTED; does not count toward useful survivors

separation_rule.executability_adapter_module: Maps accepted proposition to legal ExperimentSpec using execution constraints
separation_rule.order: Synthesis first, executability second — never filter observations to match template tool paths before synthesis
